notes: ONE RECEIPT, SEVERAL ACCOUNTS. A customer often pays one sum that covers several things. Fund Receipts now has a Split across several accounts button: each line credits its own account — different income lines, or income alongside a deposit held — and may carry its own branch or project. The Amount becomes the sum of the lines, the books take one bank entry against one credit per line, and the bank reconciliation sees ONE deposit, exactly as the bank statement will show it. The printed receipt itemises what the one payment covered. A split receipt cannot also split out VAT or the tourism levy — a multi-line taxable sale is an Invoice, which handles tax per line. CORRECTING A RECEIPT IS NOW AN EXACT COPY. Correcting a posted receipt copies its entries onto the correction exactly as they were posted, allocation by allocation, before you amend it. NO DATA RESHAPE: installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first — Backup & Export, Back up now.
